activity: Took Schmidt rebound hammer readings and UPV sound velocity scans on the compressor house columns
status_note: Uniform compressive strength indicated across all 12 test locations; no subsurface voids.

activity: Stood up heavy steel H-columns with 70-ton mobile crane and anchored with temporary wire rope guys on Train A
status_note: Columns set plumb to within 3mm over 12m vertical height.

activity: Tensioned high-strength structural bolts on column base plates and moment connections around vessel V-201
status_note: Direct tension indicators (DTIs) verified flattened to spec.

activity: Mounted lube oil skid console, ran stainless steel return lines and tied in the nitrogen accumulator vessel
status_note: Tubing runs clamped to structural channels; pressure relief valve tagged.

activity: Hung variable spring supports beneath fin-fan header and adjusted turnbuckles to cold design preset position
status_note: Spring travel pins pulled and locked in cold-load position.

activity: Circulated alkaline degreaser and citric acid chemical pickle solution through main lube oil piping loops
status_note: Passivation completed; millipore filter membrane test passed clean.

activity: Packed intumescent firestop pillows and compound into cable tray wall openings between transformer bay and switchroom
status_note: 2-hour fire rated seal completed and certified.

activity: Landed incoming power feeds and landed control wires onto terminal blocks inside MCC-B breaker cubicles
status_note: All terminations tug-tested and labeled per schematic diagram.

activity: Assembled steel battery stands, placed individual 2V stationary lead-acid cells, and torqued inter-cell bus links
status_note: Applied anti-corrosion grease on lead terminal posts; open-circuit bank voltage 126V DC.

activity: Injected secondary current using Omicron test kit to calibrate phase overcurrent and earth fault protection relays
status_note: Trip curves verified; breaker trip timing recorded at 38 milliseconds.
